headings.style: tracking-tighter, huge scales (text-5xl to text-[8vw] for hero), uppercase, bold.

labels_and_mono.style: uppercase, tracking-[0.2em], text-xs to text-sm, text-[#22D3EE] (neon cyan) or text-[#A1A1AA].

background_effects.noise: Subtle grain overlay using SVG noise or background-image pattern (fixed, pointer-events-none, opacity-[0.03]).
background_effects.grid: Faint white/5 grid lines over the black background.
background_effects.ambient_light: Blurred radial gradients (cyan #22D3EE and violet #8B5CF6) fixed in background, opacity-10 to 20, very soft (blur-[120px]).

custom_cursor.style: Glowing dot + lagging blurred ring (framer-motion or custom hook). Expands on hover over interactive elements. Displays 'VIEW' label when hovering image cards. Hide on touch devices.

layouts.hero: 100-110vh, relative, flex flex-col justify-center items-center. Eyebrow 'AIML DEPARTMENT • ADGIPS', huge stacked heading 'KRITHIM DHI'. Glowing AI sphere or abstract particles behind text.
layouts.community: Stats grid (animated count-up). Floating topic chips (AI, ML, GEN AI, etc) with floating animations.
layouts.what_we_do: Grid layout, 6 glass cards. Subdued but premium aesthetic.
layouts.events: GSAP ScrollTrigger stacked cards. Sticky container; as user scrolls, cards translate up and scale down slightly.
layouts.team: Pinned horizontal scroll section (GSAP ScrollTrigger). Huge text 'THE PEOPLE BEHIND THE MACHINE' with 10 premium profile cards scrolling horizontally.
layouts.contact: Left: Glass form (Name, Email, Subject, Message, Send). Right: Alternate contact info cards. Use sonner for success toast.

motion.scrolling: Lenis smooth scroll. Wrap root or main with Lenis setup.
motion.loader: Cinematic loading screen (1-2s): Logo, 'INITIALIZING INTELLIGENCE...', percentage counter, thin progress line loading left-to-right.
motion.gsap: useGSAP hook. ScrollTrigger for fades, pin sections, parallax elements. Staggered reveals.
signature_interactions: Side section counter '01 / 08' updating via scroll progress.

hero_ai_visual.description: Concentric rings of blue and purple. Use as ambient blurred orb behind hero text.

events_stage.description: Dark stage with 'IMAGINE EVERY THING' text. Perfect for Vision or Events placeholder.

hackathon_coding.description: Laptop screen with code, dark blue lighting. Use for 'What We Do' cards or 'Projects'.

research_team.description: Group of people in a dark room working on computers. Use for 'Research' or 'Community'.

3d_libraries.recommendation: For the custom cursor and floating interactions, Framer Motion and GSAP are preferred. If you choose to add 3D elements, use simple CSS 3D transforms or react-tsparticles for glowing ambient specs.

accessibility.focus_states: High contrast outline for keyboard focus. (e.g., focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#8B5CF6]).
accessibility.reduced_motion: Include CSS or JS logic to disable GSAP animations if window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)') is true.
accessibility.aria: Use proper ARIA labels. aria-hidden='true' for visual noise and decorative background particles.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: The website MUST be exclusively styled in dark mode. Do not add a light theme or light mode variants.
Install required dependencies: 'npm install gsap @studio-freight/lenis framer-motion lucide-react sonner clsx tailwind-merge'.
Typography: You must import 'Cabinet Grotesk' (or fallback to 'Clash Display' / 'Outfit' for big headings), 'JetBrains Mono' for labels.
Glass cards MUST strictly match: bg-white/[0.03], border-white/[0.08], backdrop-blur-2xl, rounded-[24px].
Do NOT use Shadcn section/card components for complex layouts. Build them manually with pure HTML + Tailwind to achieve custom overlaps.
Implement a cinematic loading screen that displays 'INITIALIZING INTELLIGENCE...' and unmounts after 1.5 - 2s.
Implement the Events stack using GSAP ScrollTrigger: pin the section, and iterate through cards to transform their Y and Scale based on scroll.
Implement Team horizontal scroll using GSAP ScrollTrigger. Pin the container and translate the inner flex row on the X-axis.
Implement the side counter (01/08) fixed on the right or left edge, changing index as sections reach top.
Strictly use the placeholders like [STUDENT NAME] and [EVENT TITLE] rather than inventing fake details.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
DO NOT apply universal transition (e.g., 'transition: all'). This breaks GSAP transforms. Use specific transitions ('transition-colors', 'transition-opacity').
DO NOT center align the app container. No '.App { text-align: center; }'.
Include a 'data-testid' attribute on all interactive and key informational elements.
Do NOT use complete transparent backgrounds for the floating navbar. Use glassmorphism.
Make creative, distinctive frontends. Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Emphasize asymmetric balance and luxurious spacing.
Mobile-first layouts are mandatory. Ensure huge typography scales down gracefully on small screens and disable heavy custom cursors on touch devices.
